description: ERR-PARTIAL, variant: where in a multi-row UPDATE does a lock refusal fall? A second Workspace W2 opens the file, a dynaset on T with LockEdits True and Edit on row k (FindFirst ID = k) for k = 1, 4, 8; for each k the first Database runs UPDATE T SET N = N + 1 with dbFailOnError and, again, with no options; Errors, RecordsAffected and every N are read after each; W2 then does CancelUpdate and closes the recordset.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
